verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only fragments of data portability. A Downloads API retrieves files from a session by sessionId (docs-18). The Optimize tool turns a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script that could be carried elsewhere (docs-17). Neither amounts to a comprehensive export-everything-and-leave capability. Missing for 10: account-wide data export, documented open export formats for session logs, replays, agent configs and webhooks, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and any independent evidence of migrating off the platform.
